title: CIRA-86 Atmosphere Model
text: Implement mathematical representation of 1986 CIRA atmosphere, 2 inputs, 3 outputs, {Units} sets Units Metric; {Coordinate type}, {Mean value type}, {Month} and {Action for out-of-range input} sets the out-of-range block behavior. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Units
params.values: Units Metric (MKS) (default) | English (Velocity in ft/s) | English (Velocity in kts)

params.name: Month
params.values: Month of mean value January (default) | February | March | April | May | June | July | August | September | October | November | December

params.name: Action for out-of-range input
params.values: Out-of-range block behavior None (default) | Warning | Error
